key_terms.فَعَّالٌ: Doer, Active One (emphasizing power to act)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quranic phrase 'Fa'āl limā yurīd' mean?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, this attribute (Fa‘ālun limā yurid) is often linked with divine wisdom (Hikmah), affirming that God’s actions are purposeful and not arbitrary. It underscores the concept of Divine Decree (Qadr), where God’s will is the ultimate cause of all events, yet distinct from human free will. This verse is frequently cited to refute the Jabriyyah (determinists) who claimed humans have no agency, by showing that God’s ‘doing’ encompasses both creation and the granting of choice.
